judgments.reason: The Scientific Data paper "A Large Finer-grained Affective Computing EEG Dataset" describes FACED: 123 subjects, 32-channel EEG, 28 video clips, nine emotion categories. This matches the dataset's description.
judgments.paper_title: A Large Finer-grained Affective Computing EEG Dataset

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used for formatting this dataset, not a paper describing the FACED data.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
